jobs.occupation: Fleet Performance & Reliability Manager H145 (d/f/m) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

In order to support our fleet data team in regards of technical and economic performance of the in service fleet, Airbus Helicopters is looking for a

Fleet Performance & Reliability Manager H145 (d/f/m)

Are you looking for a cross-functional role with broad visibility across Airbus Support & Services? Do you want to shape the operability of future aircraft developments while driving in-service performance for world-class helicopter fleets?

In this role, you will focus on the Airbus H145—our market-leading, twin-engine multi-mission helicopter deployed worldwide for emergency medical services (HEMS), law enforcement, military, and offshore operations. Your key objective will be to optimize the operational reliability, availability, maintenance economics, and fuel efficiency of the global H145 fleet as well as upcoming helicopter developments.

Your location

At our Donauwörth site, located on the banks of the river Danube, we develop helicopters from the initial idea to the airworthy product. Watch them take off and touch down on our own on-site test airfield.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Manage Reliability: Define and maintain reliability benchmarks for the H145 fleet and new helicopter developments.
- Act as Key Interface: Serve as the central focal point for fleet data across program management, engineering, and suppliers.
- Analyze Fleet Data: Evaluate flight hours and failure rates to optimize operational availability and costs.
- Drive Product Improvements: Identify, analyze, and prioritize technical and maintenance improvement opportunities to reduce customer costs.
- Maintain Performance Metrics: Build and manage KPI dashboards covering maintainability, costs, and fleet availability.
- Support Bidding & Proposals: Provide realistic operational and cost data for RFQs, proposals, and customer projects.
- Harmonize Methods: Standardize data analytics methodologies and tools across different helicopter programs.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
- Industry Experience: Professional experience in the aviation sector, preferably with helicopter systems knowledge.
- Analytical Mindset: Strong background in data analytics with an understanding of reliability and maintenance metrics (RAMT/DMC).
- IT Proficiency: Fluent with standard IT applications, databases, and reporting systems (ideally SAP BW).
- Skills: Proactive mindset with proven experience coordinating cross-functional activities and managing stakeholders.
- Business Acumen: Customer-centric focus combined with strong economic thinking and problem-solving skills.
- Language Skills: Professional fluency in English and German; French skills are a plus.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

A Snapshot of Your Day 

As Project Manager (f/m/d), you will ensure business continuity within the Additive Manufacturing R&D Project Management Office and support the development of additively manufactured components and innovative manufacturing projects. Your responsibilities will focus on leading complex technical projects, driving strategic planning and risk management activities, and ensuring effective governance and stakeholder communication. With your strong technical expertise, leadership skills, and extensive experience in R&D project management, you will play a key role in advancing product integration and innovation.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Leadership and coordination of cross-functional R&D projects across the entire lifecycle, from concept development to product integration
* Project planning, scheduling, resource allocation, and execution management for complex additive manufacturing initiatives
* Definition of project scope, objectives, deliverables, and governance frameworks in alignment with business and technical requirements
* Risk identification, assessment, mitigation planning, and change management to ensure project success and minimize business impact
* Vendor and stakeholder management, technical guidance, and progress reporting to support effective collaboration and decision-making
* Budget control, quality assurance, milestone tracking, and project documentation management to ensure compliance with technical, financial, and organizational standards

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Project Management, or a related technical discipline preferred
* PMP (Project Management Professional) certification preferred but not required
* Demonstrated technical project management experience with a successful track record in delivering complex R&D and product development projects
* Strong expertise in project planning and execution, including project scoping, scheduling, resource allocation, budgeting, and project documentation
* Advanced knowledge of project governance methodologies, including risk management, change management, quality assurance, and Waterfall frameworks

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

jobs.occupation: Data & AI Engineer (all genders), PharmaHera Service GmbH (Data-Warehouse-Analyst/in)
jobs.description: Deine neue Umgebung: Behind PharmaHera is Atida - one of Europe's leading online pharmacy groups, serving over 5 million customers across 9 countries. Together with the CEPD Group, we combine more than 25 years of pharmaceutical expertise with digital excellence to redefine the online pharmacy experience: We are building a trusted, personalized health ecosystem that guides people from prevention to cure - backed by medical expertise and driven by our conviction: Pharmacy is about people. Based in Berlin, we serve as the group's competence center for Germany and the Netherlands. As a specialized partner, we manage e-commerce, marketing, IT, and logistics for our local mail-order pharmacies, such as APONEO. Our European markets run on a single, standardized data platform (our Foundation layer). Your mission for the future: To transform this data infrastructure so it is not only usable by people, but specifically prepared for AI agents that read, analyze, and autonomously act on it. The role Reporting to the Data & AI Engineer Lead, you will own the data pipelines, datasets, AI agents and tools built on top of Foundation, and you will build most of them with AI agents as part of your toolchain. The role sits one level of abstraction above the code: you specify, review and take responsibility for systems rather than typing every line. Core responsibilities Pipeline development: build and optimize data flows in Apache Airflow, from our European markets into BigQuery. Modeling in BigQuery: implement tables and views in the Foundation layer, guaranteeing KPI comparability across Spain, France, Italy and Germany. Semantic layer and data contracts: keep business definitions consistent across dashboards, models and agents, and define the schema, granularity and quality a dataset guarantees. AI-assisted delivery: use Claude Code and the Anthropic API as your everyday engineering environment -- turn a requirement into a precise specification, let the agent produce the pipeline, then review, test and own the result. Building for agents: expose Foundation through MCP tools and skills so that AIDA and our decision agents can query it reliably. A dataset is finished when an agent can use it without being misled. Evaluation: build the evals, checks and monitoring that tell us whether an agent's output is correct. Unit tests are not enough for non-deterministic systems. Data products: design data products for management, finance, commercial, operations and marketing -- reusable across markets. Visualization and reporting: work with the business team on reports and consumable datasets in Apache Superset. Code and traceability: clean Python and SQL, with every task traceable through our GitLab-Coda integration. Agent-generated code included. Your Profile & Tech Stack What You Bring to the Role (Must-Haves): Education & Experience: 2+ years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering or Data Science. AI-Assisted Engineering: Regular, demonstrable use of an LLM coding agent (Claude Code or equivalent) in daily work, plus the technical judgment to critically review agent-generated code. Tech Stack & Cloud: Solid experience with Google Cloud Platform (especially BigQuery), Apache Airflow, strong SQL, data-oriented Python, and version control via Git/GitLab. Languages: Fluent English for daily collaboration within our international team. Mindset & Work Ethic: Strong analytical skills, an independent and results-focused approach ("you get the problem and context, the solution design is yours to propose"), and a commitment to deeply understanding code rather than using AI as a blind shortcut. What Rounds Off Your Profile (Nice-to-Haves): Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol), LLM APIs, ClearML, Docker, or Apache Druid. Know-how in evaluating non-deterministic systems and using BI tools (ideally Apache Superset). Industry experience in the healthcare, pharmacy, or e-commerce sectors, plus basic knowledge of German. What we are not looking for Someone who ships code they cannot explain. Someone who needs a ticket with the solution already inside it or with full requirements in place. We act fast: you get the problem, the context and access -- the design is yours to propose. Someone who uses AI as a shortcut and doesn't understand the problem they are solving. Someone who only thinks short-term. We build future-proof solutions. What You'll Get Your Work Environment: Freedom to Shape Your Role from Day 1: A position of responsibility with real opportunities for growth, where you can proactively drive initiatives and actively help shape strategies. Permanent, Full-Time Position: Long-term prospects in a future-proof market. Agile Work Environment: A motivated, dynamic team and flat hierarchies with short decision-making paths that enable fast execution. Flexibility with Team Spirit: Flexible working hours and a hybrid work model (mobile work & in-office) - with a focus on our Berlin office to foster collaboration and team cohesion. Direct Mentoring: Close collaboration and mentoring by the Data & AI Engineer Lead in a technically demanding environment. Hands-on Production Tech Stack: Real-world experience with Airflow, BigQuery, Druid, GCP, and a modern production AI stack (Claude, MCP, Agents, Evals). Professional AI Tooling: First-class AI engineering tools come as standard equipment. Your Benefits at a Glance: Health & Mobility: Urban Sports Club membership at an unbeatable price and a heavily discounted BVG corporate transit pass for your daily commute. Exclusive Perks: Attractive employee discounts on our entire APONEO product range, access to a wide variety of corporate benefits, and a Selgros card. All-Round Care: An on-campus cafeteria, free fresh fruit, vegetables, and snacks every day, plus an unlimited coffee and tea flat rate. Your Compensation & Terms: For this full-time, permanent position, we offer an attractive, market-based, and competitive compensation package. We anticipate an annual gross salary between EUR45,000 and EUR55,000 p.a. Together, we will determine your exact positioning within this range through a transparent process based on the following criteria: Your relevant practical work experience in Data & AI Engineering. Your professional qualifications and specific additional skills. Our internal salary structure to ensure fairness within the team. Equal Opportunity & Fair Pay: We don't leave fair pay to chance. We compensate all team members in equivalent positions transparently and fairly, regardless of gender or any other personal characteristic. Ready to join? Ready to actively shape the future of e-commerce and data-driven healthcare at Atida? Apply now! We look forward to receiving your CV and your earliest possible starting date.

About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Job description

In order to support the mechanical systems department, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Development Engineer (m/f/d) - Mechanical Analysis and Testing of Space Structures

We are seeking creative professionals with deep expertise in structural dynamics to tackle tasks in the mechanical analysis and testing of aerospace structures. The ideal candidate will bring initial professional experience in the mechanical design and verification of aerospace components (such as satellites, instruments, and mechanisms) and is eager to apply and further develop their academic and practical expertise.

Your location

At the Airbus site in Immenstaad, you work exactly where the future of Connected Intelligence, Space, and Air Power is taking shape. In an environment that offers visionary perspectives, you shape technological innovations across multiple domains.

Our location thrives on dialogue: on campus, you will encounter a unique network of experts in satellite technology, military aviation, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, as well as the combat cloud and ground support systems of tomorrow. The way we work together is equally dynamic—in agile teams, we tackle the most complex challenges, ranging from AI-powered Earth observation to secure cloud architectures. Anyone seeking technological excellence and interdisciplinary collaboration will find the ideal environment here.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.

- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Structural Analysis: Support the execution of static and dynamic structural analyses for aerospace structures, ensuring result plausibility through manual verification methods.
- Performance Analysis: Conduct mechanical performance analyses for high-precision instruments and structures designed for space applications.
- Testing & Simulation: Contribute to the simulation and oversight of vibration testing for satellites and their sub-components.
- FEM Modeling: Develop mathematical structural models using Finite Element Analysis (FEA), focusing on application-oriented structural idealization and physical model validation using Hyperworks and NASTRAN.
- Verification of Joints: Perform strength verification for joining elements in accordance with VDI and ESA standards.
- Tool Development: Assist in developing internal Matlab-based tools for workflow optimization and the processing of analytical and test data.
- Documentation: Maintain comprehensive documentation of all processes, specifically regarding mathematical models and analytical/test outcomes.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Education: Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline.
- Experience: Prior first professional experience in the design and verification of aerospace structures is highly preferred.
- Technical Expertise: Advanced proficiency in static/dynamic structural analysis (FEM) and manual calculation methods.
- Software Skills: Proficiency in Nastran and Hyperworks.
- Specific Knowledge: Solid understanding of space-specific requirements; experience with fiber-composite structure design and calculation is a plus.
- Soft Skills: A proactive, structured work style with the ability to work both independently and effectively within a team.
- Communication: Excellent communication skills.
- Languages: Fluency in English (written and spoken) is mandatory, proficiency in German is an advantage.

Part-time 50 % (20 h/week) to start, potential option to move to full-time after 6 months  · Start as soon as possible · English-speaking role

We help people pipette light. Our optoWELL is a programmable LED illumination platform for 24- and 96-well plates, used by labs worldwide in optogenetics, photopharmacology and photodynamic therapy. We are a small team in Freiburg and sell directly to scientists around the globe. To grow, we need one more person who wants to leave the bench and create a lasting role in our startup with us.

What you will own

- Finding researchers who work with light
- Turning them into qualified leads
- Reaching out, following up, and handing warm conversations over to our CEO
- Keeping the pipeline clean and reporting on it
- A smaller share of routine sales admin (quotes, order confirmations, invoices)

You will not be an assistant. You get a clearly defined area, your own numbers, a documented process to start from – and the freedom to improve it.

What you bring

- Some background in light-based research – or the curiosity to dive into it with us; it is a small, friendly field and we will show you around
- A Master's degree or PhD in biology, biochemistry, biotechnology, pharmacy, chemistry or a related field – you can read a paper and pull out what matters
- Excellent written English; German is helpful for day-to-day work but not required
- You enjoy writing short, personal messages and are not discouraged by the fact that most people don't reply
- Structured, self-reliant work over weeks with a weekly check-in rather than daily supervision; solid Excel skills
- Nice to have: experience with CRM tools or AI-assisted literature work

What we offer

- A proven, documented sales process that already works – you copy it first, then improve it and make it your own if you can
- A role built around one measurable outcome – conversations booked with qualified scientists – rather than a to-do list
- Direct work with the founder, short decision paths, real insight into how a scientific instrument is sold worldwide
- Flexible hours, remote days possible after onboarding, office at the Freiburg Innovation Center (FRIZ)
- €21,000– €25,000 for the 50 % part time role depending on experience. €42,000–50,000 gross per year at full-time equivalent  depending on experience – i.e. ; the same rate applies if the role grows to full-time

What we are really looking for

Someone who is curious about other people's science and would rather understand a lab's actual problem than pitch a product. Someone who works on their own steam, says so when something is not working, and treats scientists and colleagues with the same respect. If that sounds like you, this is not a side role – it is a seat at the core of a small team.

How this works

You will work directly with me, Kathrin – co-founder, CEO, and so far the one doing this job. Send me an email with your CV and two or three sentences on why you want to leave the bench (no cover letter please, and no multi-page AI slop): k.brenker@optobiolabs.com. Then it is simple: a short conversation, a  two- to three-hour trial task so we both see what the job actually feels like, and fast feedback – you will hear from me within a week, either way.

jobs.description:
The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.

We investigate how cancer develops, identify cancer risk factors and search for new cancer prevention strategies. We develop new methods with which tumors can be diagnosed more precisely and cancer patients can be treated more successfully. Every contribution counts – whether in research, administration or infrastructure. This is what makes our daily work so meaningful and exciting.

The Single-cell Open Lab at the German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is looking, starting from December 2026, for a Research Software Engineer / Software Developer for Imaging and Spatial Omics Data.

The core facilities, Single-Cell Open Lab and the Omics IT and Data Management Core Facility (ODCF) at the DKFZ, provide infrastructure and workflows for single-cell and spatial omics projects. To strengthen our teams from September 2026, we are seeking a Research Software Engineer / Software Developer for imaging and spatial omics data within the ID3:bio 2.0 project (https://gerbi-gmb.de/i3dbio/).
ID3:bio 2.0 is a DFG-funded project that aims to deliver tools and strategies for the FAIR management of imaging and spatial omics data. Together with the universities of Düsseldorf and Tübingen, we develop and implement standards for metadata, file formats, data-exchange strategies, and long-term archiving.

Your Tasks

You will work in an interdisciplinary team of software developers, bioinformaticians, system administrators, and wet lab scientists, with software development at the center of your role:

- Develop and extend our GUIDE metadata platform (a Kotlin-based application) to annotate generic (meta)data and to import non-sequencing data types into the ODCF infrastructure
- Design and build the integration of the OMERO imaging platform with genomic data (OTP) within the ODCF infrastructure
- Design and implement user and permission management across the imaging and genomics systems
- Implement metadata schemas and packaging formats such as RO-Crate for spatial data
- Build tools to collect, organize, and validate research (meta)data
- Co-organize and take part in hackathons
- Organize workshops and train users to work in line with the FAIR principles

Your Profile

If you enjoy building software in an interdisciplinary team and want to enable exciting research by easing data flow for more robust and excellent analysis, this position is for you.

- Master's degree (or equivalent qualification and relevant professional experience) in computer science, software engineering, or a related field
- Substantial software development experience, including professional proficiency in Kotlin (our GUIDE platform is Kotlin-based) or Java
- Proficiency in at least one further language such as Python or JavaScript
- Experience with system administration, container and cloud technologies, and Linux
- Genuine interest in the biological and life-science background of the data — curiosity is essential, but no prior training in biology is required
- Ability to solve complex problems in a structured, well-documented way together with internal and external partners
- Willingness to explain complex technical workflows to non-specialists
- Very good command of English

Advantageous

- Experience in research data management (omics and/or imaging data)
- Experience with OMERO and imaging data
- Experience with ontologies, RO-Crate, and the SpatialData framework
- Experience in open-source software engineering and HPC
- Experience in organizing hackathons and community engagement

How to apply:

Please provide a motivation letter, CV, and highest education certificate. The motivation letter should clearly state your contribution to the project in reference to the expected skills. Please also state your own key interests and expectations for your role in the project.

- Excellent framework conditions: state-of-the-art equipment and opportunities for international networking at the highest level

jobs.occupation: Postdoc - Characterization of CHO Host Cell Proteins (Biochemiker/in)
jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

Tasks & responsibilities

- You will characterize and investigate CHO host cell proteins, with a particular focus on critical and difficult-to-remove species that may affect downstream processing and product stability.
- Using advanced mass spectrometry-based approaches, you will identify, quantify, and profile host cell proteins and support impurity risk assessment through data-driven analyses.
- You will establish, optimize, and apply analytical and functional assays to evaluate host cell protein behavior at trace levels throughout different purification stages.
- Through recombinant protein expression strategies, you will enable the in-depth characterization of selected host cell proteins under controlled experimental conditions.
- In close collaboration with downstream process development and analytics, you will investigate interactions between host cell proteins and therapeutic proteins and translate findings into risk mitigation strategies.
- As principal investigator for research and technology projects, you will lead scientific studies, oversee project execution and data interpretation, supervise students and technical staff, and communicate results effectively to stakeholders and management.

Requirements

- PhD in Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Bioengineering, Chemical Engineering, Biology, or a related scientific discipline
- Strong expertise in protein biochemistry and molecular characterization, ideally including experience with host cell proteins (HCPs)
- Hands-on experience with mass spectrometry-based protein identification and quantification methods, preferably with a focus on host cell protein analysis
- Experience in MS data processing and analysis using bioinformatics tools, including both raw and processed datasets; knowledge of recombinant protein expression and purification is highly desirable
- Solid understanding of downstream processing concepts, chromatography principles, and data-driven experimental design and quantitative data analysis
- Proven ability to work independently and collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams, supported by a strong scientific publication record and excellent English communication, scientific writing, and documentation skills

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.
